content.comment_body: I'm unable to access my files from OneDrive, which hasn’t been an issue until now. When I try to open them directly within [product_name], the files aren't found. This issue appears after a colleague performed a software update, which may be related. I've also noticed that the file icons have changed—sometimes it's just a black square, other times it's a square with a sheet of paper.

Your screenshots are too small to see any details clearly. Which software version are you using? For Modbus Network Project files, you need at least [product_name] [version_no]. An earlier version can't open these files.

I've found that the issue happens when opening files with [product_name] [version_no]. However, I also have [version_no] installed on my computer, and using that version allows me to open the files without problems. The icon is now blue.
That's expected behavior; it appears the same way on my end as well.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues opening Modbus project files with [product_name] [version_no] following a recent software update. The files had previously opened without issue. Using [version_no] resolves the problem, but a change in file icon design has caused confusion.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates backward compatibility and seamless access to project files post-update, and wants clearer, more consistent file iconography to avoid confusion.
